text: I can understand why you'd be disappointed about not being chosen to read your poem at the open-mic event. It's natural to feel that way. You might want to take some time to think about what you want to get out of writing, and then consider your options. If the organizers offer feedback, you could ask for it. You could then decide whether to revise this poem, start a new one, or take a break. Keep in mind that not being chosen doesn't necessarily mean anything about your writing or your potential as a writer.
